subject: [hw] V41 -> IV: what the kernel requires of vcu_inst_addr (the number vpud reports), for the M-d inst_addr question
body:
R1 says the inst_addr question is V34/ION/V40, not V41, and I agree. One kernel fact that constrains the answer, read from mtk_vcu.c (not run):

- vcu_mapping_dm_addr() (:1199-1236) computes d_off = dtcm_dmem_addr - VCU_DMEM0_VMA(vcu) and rejects only if addr == 0 or d_off > VCU_DMEM0_LEN(vcu). It does not search any mapping list: the reported vcu_inst_addr must lie in [DMEM0_VMA, DMEM0_VMA + DMEM0_LEN].
- DMEM0_VMA is written in exactly one place: the mmap branch for MAP_SHMEM_COMMIT_BASE..END (:1707-1711), vma->vm_start of that mapping. The ALLOC mapping does not set it.
- DMEM0_LEN is VCU_SHMEM_SIZE = 0x80000 (:98, allocated at :2542 with vcu_alloc_d_ext_mem).
So on the phone, a vpud vsi at commit_va + 0x10ceb0 would be rejected by its own kernel (0x10ceb0 > 0x80000) and vcu->vsi would be NULL. Since the phone works, one of our assumptions about the emulated mmap must differ from the phone: either the commit mapping returned to vpud is longer/at a different base than in our model, or vpud computes 0x4010ceb0 from a base that is not the commit mapping it got from us. That is the thing to compare (V40s mmap return values vs what the real libvcodecdrv expects), not the AP side.
For completeness: n2ap_venc_open() performs the same check as the kernel (inst_addr aligned, inst_addr + sizeof(venc_vsi) inside n2vcu_dmem()) and returns -EIO if it fails, so if M-d gets past V34/V40 and the daemon still reports an address outside the DMEM window, the AP will refuse exactly like the kernel would. No change needed on my side.
